Load a policy as the proxy does, and list the package entries that do nothing. Exits 1 if it is refused

Usage: waharoa policy check [OPTIONS] <PATH>

Arguments:
  <PATH>  The policy file

Options:
      --as-of <YYYY-MM-DD>  Judge the policy as of this date [default: today, UTC]
      --strict              Also exit 1 when an entry changes nothing or never wins
  -h, --help                Print help
